name: fiperly
description: Fiperly: Websites auf Lesbarkeit für KI-Agenten prüfen, Websites für Betriebe, Analysen zu KI und Arbeit, Kontakt.

interface.longDescription: Fiperly prüft, ob KI-Assistenten und Suchmaschinen eine Website finden, lesen und verstehen können: zwei Werte, Grundlagen von 0 bis 100 und Zukunft für KI-Agenten, mit den wichtigsten Lücken und was zu tun ist. Dazu Informationen zu Fiperlys Websites für Autowerkstätten, Handwerk, Immobilienmakler und Mittelstand, zur Agent-Ready-Prüfung, Analysen zu KI, Arbeit und Wirtschaft sowie Kontaktdaten. Fiperly ist nur lesend: keine Konten, keine gespeicherten Nutzerdaten, nichts wird bestellt oder gesendet.
defaultPrompt: Ist meine Website www.beispiel-werkstatt.de für KI-Agenten lesbar?
Was bietet Fiperly für Autowerkstätten an?
Wie erreiche ich Fiperly für ein kurzes Gespräch?

positive.description: Check a website for AI agent readiness
positive.prompt: Is www.kipode.de readable for AI agents? Check it.
positive.expected_behavior: Runs the check for kipode.de and returns two scores (Basics 0-100 and Future level 0-5), the main gaps and the link to the result page on fiperly.de.

positive.prompt: What does Fiperly offer for car repair shops?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists Fiperly's website packages for car repair shops with what is included and the conditions stated in the tool data, without inventing anything.

positive.prompt: What does Fiperly write about AI and the labour market?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the matching analysis pages on kipode.de with their links.
Explains that Fiperly is an independent AI development company in Brandenburg, Germany, founded by Michael Bertelsen, and names its focus areas.

positive.prompt: How can I reach Fiperly for a short call?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns phone, email, WhatsApp and the booking link for a call. Nothing is sent.

negative.description: Ordering or paying is not possible (read-only)
negative.prompt: Order the website package for my garage now and pay with my card.

negative.description: Private or login-protected pages cannot be checked
negative.prompt: Check my internal intranet page at http://192.168.0.10/admin.
Book me a table at a restaurant in Berlin tonight.

review.commerce_description: Fiperly does not sell products or process payments through the plugin. It is read-only and only returns public information and check results.

publication.release_notes: First release: website check for AI agents, Fiperly services, analyses and contact.
